amenities.title: Camp Amenities & Inclusions
amenities.subtitle: Everything you need for an unhurried, comfortable stay by the Red Sea
amenities.transferBannerDesc: Door-to-door shuttle buses available from: Cairo • Alexandria • El Mahalla • Mansoura • Tanta • Kafr El Sheikh (at discounted rates).
amenities.transferWaMessage: Hello Droub Camp, I would like to inquire about transfer bus schedules and rates to the camp.
amenities.item1Desc: All room rates include freshly prepared breakfast and dinner every day, served with authentic Bedouin flavors.
amenities.item2Desc: On-site restaurant for lunch and snacks, plus a cafe serving fresh juices, herbal mountain teas, and specialty coffee.
amenities.item3Desc: Located right on Ras Shitan beach: rocky reef ideal for vibrant snorkeling, plus a sandy stretch for calm swimming.
amenities.item4Desc: Complimentary snorkeling masks and snorkels for all camp guests to explore the rich marine life.
amenities.item5Desc: Daily beach games and evening campfire sessions are free. Kayak rentals available for a nominal fee.
amenities.item6Desc: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in common lounges so you can stay connected whenever desired.
amenities.item7Desc: Door-to-camp transportation available from Cairo, Alexandria, El Mahalla, Mansoura, Tanta, and Kafr El Sheikh (extra fee).

about.title: Droub Camp — Your Authentic Sinai Sanctuary
about.defaultP1: Droub Camp is nestled directly on the renowned Ras Shitan beach in Nuweiba, South Sinai, where rugged red mountains plunge straight into the turquoise Gulf of Aqaba. Designed as a sanctuary from modern city rush, we believe true luxury lies in simplicity, purity, and nature.
about.defaultP2: Whether you wish to snorkel pristine house reefs straight from our rocky shoreline, unwind on the sand, or hike hidden canyons like Wadi El Washwash and the Colored Canyon, Droub Camp offers the ultimate atmosphere to reconnect.
about.pillar1Desc: Untouched shoreline with a marine-rich rocky reef for snorkeling and a sandy patch for swimming.
about.pillar2Desc: Far from commercial resorts and crowds, where only gentle waves and Sinai mountain breeze are heard.
about.pillar3Desc: Evenings around the campfire sipping wild Sinai herbal tea under some of the clearest skies on Earth.
about.pillar4Desc: A warm, welcoming family environment dedicated to making your Sinai escape restorative and unforgettable.
